verdict.rationale: Name.com's Core API has a documented webhook subscription endpoint that delivers real-time notifications for domain and account events. Named event types back this up, including `domain.transfer.status_change` and `domain.registry.compliance_notice`, and the renewals guide also references webhooks. Missing for 10: documented payload signing/verification and retry/delivery semantics, a full event catalog, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Creates a webhook subscription to receive real-time notifications about specific domain or account events (e.g. transfer completions, renewals).
Subscribe to **`domain.transfer.status_change`** webhook events to track progress automatically.
